description: Shared org preset for tpsdev-ai repositories. Establishes the supply-chain posture: pin version updates, enforce a 7-day bake-time cooldown, and group minor, patch, pin and digest updates so review surface stays small. Every update is proposal-only (automerge: false) — it must pass the full CI suite + K&S review before merge. See https://github.com/tpsdev-ai/flair/blob/main/docs/supply-chain-policy.md. Docker image digest pins are PROPOSED via Renovate's docker:pinDigests preset for Dockerfiles, compose files and workflow container/service images (in current Renovate the preset exempts argocd, devcontainer, helmv3 and pyenv); like every update here they are PRs, never automerged, so the protection — a republished tag cannot change the bytes we build or test on — holds for an image once its pin PR is merged.

packageRules.description: Group bun + npm minor, patch, pin and digest updates.
Group Python minor, patch, pin and digest updates.
Major updates have no group name by default.
CodeQL Action major updates share one Renovate group name. Minor, patch, pin and digest CodeQL Action updates use the github-actions group.
Group minor, patch, pin and digest GitHub Actions updates.
Group Docker minor, patch, pin and digest updates.
